Stats.title: Room Statistics
Stats.noEntriesStats: No entries found to generate statistics.
Stats.tooltipTotalExpenses: Sum of all shared group expenses in the room. If debt repayments or transfers between members were recorded as regular expenses, they artificially inflate this total.
Stats.tooltipTotalLoans: Sum of direct cash loans between members (negative amount entries). Normal shared expenses with shares are not counted here.
Stats.tooltipTotalSettlements: Sum of direct debt repayments and transfers (matching keywords like settle, repayment, return, transfer, etc.). These settle existing debts and are not counted as room expenses.
Stats.tooltipAverageExpense: Total expenses divided equally by the number of active participants. If members have unequal share weights (e.g. 1 individual vs a couple with 2 shares), this average does not represent personal expected spending.
Stats.tooltipBiggestExpense: Single largest expense record in the room. Loans and debt settlements are excluded.
Stats.tooltipPaid: How much money this member physically paid out of pocket for the group (including paying for others and any repayments recorded as expenses).
Stats.tooltipOwes: Member's allocated share of expenses ('consumption') based on entry percentages. If someone repaid a debt to you via an expense entry, your 'owes' temporarily increases, though your net balance remains accurate.
Stats.tooltipSettled: Debt settlement balance. Positive (+) means the member repaid debt to others; negative (−) means the member received debt repayment.
Stats.tooltipNet: Final net balance (Paid − Owes + Settled). Green (+) means the group owes this amount back to you. Red (−) means you owe this amount to others. The sum of all member nets strictly equals 0.
Stats.settlementMapSubtitle: Optimal transfers to settle all room debts
Stats.settlementMapTooltip: Group debt simplification consolidates pairwise debt chains so everyone settles with the minimum possible transfers.
Stats.allSettledDesc: No members have outstanding balances in this room.
Stats.simplifiedModeTooltip: Debt simplification: consolidates debt chains for minimal transfers
Stats.directModeTooltip: Direct settlements: pairwise net balance of shared expenses between each pair
Stats.settlementMapSubtitleDirect: Direct pairwise balances between each pair of members
Stats.comparisonBadge: ⚡ {simplifiedCount} instead of {directCount} direct transfers (-{savedCount} transfers, {savedVolume} {currency} in transit payments eliminated)
Stats.comparisonBadgeEqual: Direct and simplified transfers are identical (no transit intermediaries)

Customization.title: Customize Experience
Customization.subtitle: Enable or disable optional features, customize all labels, and configure core app behavior.
Customization.labelsSectionDesc: Customize headers and button labels. Leave blank to use defaults.
Customization.addEntryButtonLabelTitle: Add Entry Submit Button (Default: Add entry)
Customization.syncTotalButtonLabelTitle: Sync Bill Total Button (Default: Sync total)
Customization.customPresetsDesc: Save custom member percentage splits (★ Presets bar) and re-apply them anytime.
Customization.premadePresetsDesc: Quick selection buttons (Just Me, Everyone, Select None, Split Equally).
Customization.autoBalanceDesc: One-click shortcut (+X ILS) to distribute unallocated remaining amounts evenly.
Customization.syncTotalDesc: Quick button to update total bill amount to match the sum of individual shares.
Customization.currencyConverterDesc: Input foreign currencies with live exchange rate lookup and conversions.
Customization.roomStatsDesc: Access the room statistics page with spending breakdowns and graphs.
Customization.detailedBalanceDesc: Link under the room balance to inspect detailed member-to-member balances.
Customization.debtSettlementMapDesc: Visual interactive flowchart showing optimal debt transfers in stats.
Customization.exportReportsDesc: Download expense sheets and settlement summaries as Excel or PDF.
Customization.entryEditsHistoryDesc: Audit log showing timestamps and values for past entry edits.
Customization.entryShareModalDesc: Generate shareable image cards and summary text for entries.
Customization.devSectionBannerDesc: Disabling core system mechanisms is strictly intended for resilience testing, debugging, and stress testing edge cases. Toggling these options breaks data integrity or prevents normal UI interactions!
Customization.coreSumBadgeDesc: Shows the sum of distributed shares and validation status (✓ or error indicator).
Customization.coreSumBadgeLoss: Hides the sum indicator (Sum: X / Y ILS) in the split list headers.
Customization.coreSumBadgeBreak: Users cannot see if assigned shares equal the bill total. Forces mental calculations, increasing human errors and confusing submit-button locks.
Customization.coreEntryEditingDesc: Allows modifying previously created entries in the ledger.
Customization.coreEntryEditingLoss: Hides edit action buttons and disables the Edit Entry modal completely.
Customization.coreEntryEditingBreak: Mistakes and typos in past transactions cannot be edited. Users must delete entries completely and re-enter them or perform manual compensating entries.
Customization.corePersonSelectionDesc: Allows clicking on member cards to select or deselect them from splits.
Customization.corePersonSelectionLoss: Clicking member cards is blocked; participants included in the split are frozen.
Customization.corePersonSelectionBreak: Users cannot adjust who participates in paying or splitting expenses. Individualized expense attribution becomes impossible.
Customization.coreManualShareInputsDesc: Numeric input fields for setting exact monetary shares per person.
Customization.coreManualShareInputsLoss: Amount input fields inside member cards are disabled or hidden.
Customization.coreManualShareInputsBreak: Unequal bill splits cannot be entered. Users are locked to equal division, breaking uneven expense splitting.
Customization.coreEnforceSumValidationTitle: Enforce Bill Sum Validation (100% Strict Check)
Customization.coreEnforceSumValidationDesc: Strict client-side check ensuring shares match total bill amount before saving.
Customization.coreEnforceSumValidationLoss: Bypasses the requirement that total split shares must equal 100% / total bill amount.
Customization.coreEnforceSumValidationBreak: CRITICAL INTEGRITY BREAK: Allows storing entries where split sum ≠ 100%. Destroys zero-sum room balance and breaks debt settlement algorithms.
Customization.coreBalanceDisplayDesc: Main financial indicator at the top of the room page showing net balance.
Customization.coreBalanceDisplayLoss: Hides the room net balance card at the top of the screen.
Customization.coreBalanceDisplayBreak: Users lose immediate visibility into whether they owe or are owed money without drilling down into detail reports.
Customization.coreEntryDeletionDesc: Allows permanently removing erroneous entries from the room ledger.
Customization.coreEntryDeletionLoss: Hides the trash/delete icon across all entry lists.
Customization.coreEntryDeletionBreak: Accidental duplicates or erroneous records cannot be deleted, permanently distorting room balances.
